title: Expectation on a product space
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f:\Omega^{n+1}\to\mathbb R$. The expectation of $f$ under the product law of $n+1$ independent samples from $\pi$ equals the expectation over the last sample $a\sim\pi$ of the expectation over $n$ independent samples $x\sim\pi$ of $f(x_1,\ldots,x_n,a)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
